correctness.rationale: For the exact two-patch mass-action six-ODE model with 0<a<b, equal migration d>0 and mass N=2, stationarity of patch totals gives one mass per patch. Vanishing determinants of the two positive Metzler infection matrices subtract to (1+d)(b-a)(s1-s2)=0, so s1=s2. The unique positive Perron zero of L(s), increasing on [0,1], exists precisely if Lambda(d)>0; second determinant root cannot have positive Perron vectors. Equating per-patch infected mass forces equal strain amplitudes and unique (p,q,q,p). Linearization splits even/odd Hurwitz 2x2 blocks with negative trace and positive determinants, plus eigenvalue -2d on fixed total mass; this proves local, not global, attraction. As d grows with a+b>2, the odd slow eigenvalue is -[(b-a)^2(a+b-2)/(4(a+b)^2)]/d+o(1/d); the other slow even eigenvalue stays bounded negative. For a+b<2,b>1 the invasion cutoff is d_c=(b-1)(1-a)/(2-a-b), strict. Independently differentiated full six equations at a=1/2,b=3,d=3/2 and obtained residual zero and exact characteristic polynomial z(z+3)(8z²+34z+5)(8z²+34z+29)/64. Critical a+b=2 strong migration asymptotics not claimed.
